text:
sam (Console PM): Quick proposal — we should add a per-route KPI dashboard in Console that includes token-level latency breakouts (p50/p95/p99), throughput (req/s + tokens/s), and error rate. Need ability to slice by kernel / kv_hit / batch_size / model_family.

maria (Prod Analytics): +1. Important that p99 on tokens is actually visible (we're seeing regressions that per-request hides). Do we want raw per-token timings or histograms?

jyoti (eng-runtime): Prefer emitting histograms from the runtime. Per-token raw traces are too high-cardinality. Plan: runtime emits Prom histogram for token latency with exemplar trace_id for sampled requests. Labels: route, kernel, model_family, kv_hit, batch_size_bucket.

leon (infra-sre): Cardinality/ingest costs are the main danger. Keep label values bounded: kernel (cuda_f32/cuda_int8/cpu), model_family (gptx/optx/llama2), batch_size buckets (1,2,4,8+), kv_hit true/false. Sample tokens for exemplars (eg 0.5-1% of tokens). For aggregate views use histogram + pre-aggregated rollups into ClickHouse.

metrics-bot: Example metrics (suggested):
  - redwood_route_token_latency_seconds_bucket{route="<route>",kernel="cuda_f32",kv_hit="true",le="0.01"} -> histogram
  - redwood_route_token_latency_seconds_sum / _count -> compute means
  - redwood_route_tokens_generated_total{route="<route>",kernel="..."} -> counter
  - redwood_route_requests_total{status="ok|error"} -> counter (for error-rate)
  - redwood_route_token_latency_exemplar{trace_id="..."} -> exemplar link to trace store

sam (Console PM): UI ideas: main panel per-route with p50/p95/p99 lines for token-latency, stacked breakdown showing % of tokens by latency bucket, throughput sparkline, error-rate donut. Secondary panel: heatmap token_position vs latency (average/95) so we can spot KV-cache cold regions. Ability to filter to only kv_hit=true or by kernel.

jyoti (eng-runtime): Implementation notes: insert timer around token emission (post-attention -> generation kernel). Emit to Prom with buckets roughly: [0.001,0.002,0.004,0.008,0.016,0.032,0.064,0.128,0.256,0.512,1.024]. Also increment counters for kv_hit/miss per-token. Add exemplar for the 99th percentile buckets so console can link to full trace in Jaeger/TraceDB.

maria (Prod Analytics): For p99 accuracy we should compute percentiles in the metrics backend (ClickHouse/Prometheus remote read) rather than client quantiles. Also keep daily rollups for historical regressions.

leon (infra-sre): Staging rollout plan: enable histograms for a subset of routes (chat.v1,embed.short) with sampling on 10% tokens for 48h, then drop to 1%. Monitor ingestion + egress.

sam (Console PM): Action items: (1) eng-runtime to add histogram + exemplar instrumentation (jyoti) — ETA 2w for staging. (2) infra to validate ingestion and cost (leon) — ETA 1w. (3) prod-analytics to define dashboard panels and percentile queries (maria) — ETA 1w. (4) Console to mock UI and wire exemplar links to traces (sam) — ETA 1.5w.

jyoti (eng-runtime): ack. I’ll open a PR with the runtime timers + prometheus metric names + config for bucket set and sampling. Will include a small example curl to show metrics.

sam (Console PM): thanks — if everyone can add blockers to the PR we’ll sync next Tue. :thumbsup:
